'''Onway''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Major/Legends|major]] who served in the military forces of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. Tan-skinned and dark-haired, she carried a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] and was stationed at [[House Organa (estate)|the Organa estate]] as a combat instructor.
